visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A ginger and white cat lies on a soft gray textured blanket, looking curiously to the left. A blue string or shoelace is dangled and moved in front of its face. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a nearby window. Pink and white Chinese text is centered on the screen. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room with white shelving filled with various objects like helmets and books. A man wearing a gray long-sleeved shirt holds up a long blue shoelace with both hands. The cat sits quietly in a yellow-rimmed bed on the desk behind him. (3) The man places the blue shoelace around the back of his neck, letting the two ends hang down over his shoulders. He is wearing glasses and looking down toward a camera. (4) The man holds a black professional camera with a large fuzzy gray shotgun microphone attached to the top. He leans down and sways his torso and head from side to side, pointing the lens at the cat in the yellow bed. (5) The final phase shows the resulting camera footage: a shaky, close-up shot of the cat in the yellow bed. The blue shoelace ends swing across the camera lens periodically. The cat remains still, looking somewhat unimpressed and sleepy under the bright indoor light.
